title: Write an architecture decision record (B2)
summary: Write a concise architecture decision record with context, decision, alternatives and consequences.
learningObjectives: State the context and the forces behind a decision
Record the decision and the alternatives rejected
Describe positive and negative consequences honestly

sections.title: Decision notes
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Team notes. Decision needed: how to send events between the order service and the shipping service. Context: the order service calls the shipping service directly; when shipping is slow, orders fail. Options discussed: keep direct calls with retries; use a message queue; use a shared database table. The team leans toward a message queue. Constraint: the team has no experience operating a queue and has two months.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Văn bản ngắn ghi một quyết định kiến trúc và lý do.
vocabulary.example: We wrote a decision record for the queue.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết decision record thành hai từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Tình huống và lực tác động dẫn tới quyết định.
vocabulary.example: The context is a slow shipping service.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Lựa chọn khác đã được cân nhắc.
vocabulary.example: We rejected the shared table alternative.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: al-TER-na-tive.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều xảy ra sau quyết định, tốt hoặc xấu.
vocabulary.example: One consequence is extra operational work.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a consequence of + quyết định.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Một quyết định mới thay cho quyết định trước.
vocabulary.example: This record supersedes the earlier decision.

expressions.phrase: The context is ___, and the constraint is ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu bối cảnh và ràng buộc.
expressions.example: The context is a slow shipping service, and the constraint is a two-month timeline.

expressions.meaning: Ghi quyết định và lý do.
expressions.example: We decided to use a message queue because it isolates slow consumers.
We rejected a shared table because it couples both services to one schema.

expressions.phrase: As a consequence, ___; the downside is ___.
expressions.meaning: Ghi hệ quả tốt và xấu.
expressions.example: As a consequence, orders no longer fail when shipping is slow; the downside is extra operational work.

exercises.question: Which sentence records a rejected alternative with a reason?
options: We rejected a shared table because it couples both services to one schema.
We looked at a few other things too.
The shared table was a bit unpopular.
correctAnswer: We rejected a shared table because it couples both services to one schema.
exercises.explanation: Phương án bị loại cần có lý do cụ thể.

exercises.question: Sửa lỗi: câu "We decided using a queue because it isolates slow consumers." sai dạng động từ. Điền dạng đúng thay cho "using".
Sắp xếp các phần của decision record.
exercises.explanation: Bối cảnh, quyết định, phương án bị loại, hệ quả.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
correctAnswer: decision record - bản ghi quyết định
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: We wrote a ___ for the queue.
exercises.explanation: "decision record" nghĩa là bản ghi quyết định.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: The ___ is a slow shipping service.

performanceTask.title: Write a decision record
performanceTask.scenario: Your team has chosen an approach; you write the decision record so that future engineers understand why.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: From the short team notes, write a decision record in English (90 to 150 words): context, decision, alternatives rejected and consequences. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write an architecture decision record in English, 90 to 150 words: the context, the decision, the alternatives you rejected and the consequences, good and bad.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Decision record: events between the order and shipping services. Context: the order service calls the shipping service directly, and when shipping is slow, customer orders fail. The team has two months and no experience operating a queue. Decision: we decided to use a managed message queue, because it isolates slow consumers and lets orders succeed independently. Alternatives rejected: direct calls with retries, because retries add load during an outage; and a shared database table, because it couples both services to one schema. Consequences: orders no longer fail when shipping is slow, and we can add consumers later. The downside is new operational work, so we will add alerts and a training session before launch. Review date: three months after release.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the record again in English. Keep the structure and make the consequences more balanced.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write a decision record for a different decision, such as choosing a database.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write a decision record for another decision without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Context, decision, alternatives, consequences
rubric.description: The record has all four parts.

anchors.met: Each alternative has a reason and the consequences include a downside.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing or the downside is ignored.

rubric.label: Precise language
rubric.description: Sentences are precise and use decision vocabulary.

rubric.label: Neutral, durable tone
rubric.description: The tone suits a record that others read later.

anchors.met: Neutral and complete, without team slang.
anchors.notMet: Uses chatty or time-bound phrases like "recently".
